audit.whatIsWrong: Ryze is given a 'shielded burst' in whys[6], spikes[3] and late — he has no shield. The page also never states the three interactions that decide this lane: Alpha Strike is UNTARGETABLE (20s at rank 1, shortened by his basic attacks), Meditate is a CHANNEL that Rune Prison cancels outright, and Highlander makes him immune to slows — so an un-Fluxed cage does literally nothing while his ult is up.
audit.why: The Highlander interaction is the decisive one: Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux, and its fallback slow is negated by his R. Without Flux, the button is blank in exactly the fight that matters. Wuju Style's true damage also means resistances are the wrong purchase.
